description: This file defines API service functions for interacting with backend endpoints related to tests and users, including functions for fetching health status, listing, creating, updating, and deleting tests and users.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles fetch responses, parsing JSON or text based on content type, and throws errors for non-OK responses.

methods.name: jsonFetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with JSON headers and processes the response using handleResponse.

methods.name: getHealth
methods.description: Fetches health status from a specified or default URL.

methods.name: listTests
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tests from the backend.

methods.name: createTest
methods.description: Creates a new test with provided payload.

methods.name: getTest
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific test by ID.

methods.name: submitResponses
methods.description: Submits responses for a specific test.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided payload.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user by ID.
